additionalInfo.description: Relative humidity alarm and dry-run board LED automation. Attach after telemetry storage.

configuration.jsScript:
return msgType === "POST_TELEMETRY_REQUEST" && !!metadata && !!msg &&
    (metadata.deviceName === "classroom-01-sim" || metadata.deviceName === "classroom-01") &&
    msg.deviceId === metadata.deviceName && typeof msg.humidity === "number" &&
    isFinite(msg.humidity) && msg.humidity >= 0 && msg.humidity <= 100;
return "LED candidate" + " " + JSON.stringify({device: metadata.deviceName, sampleTs: metadata.ts, data: msg});
return "LED ACK accepted" + " " + JSON.stringify({device: metadata.deviceName, sampleTs: metadata.ts, data: msg});
return "LED ACK rejected" + " " + JSON.stringify({device: metadata.deviceName, sampleTs: metadata.ts, data: msg});

nodes.name: LED RPC failed or timed out

configuration.jsScript: return "LED RPC failed or timed out" + " " + JSON.stringify({device: metadata.deviceName, sampleTs: metadata.ts, data: msg});
return "Humidity rule processing failed" + " " + JSON.stringify({device: metadata.deviceName, sampleTs: metadata.ts, data: msg});
